Create Connector & Trigger Sync

4 steps

Connector management lifecycle: empty page → add GDrive connector → configure UC scope → trigger sync → sync history appears.

Create Connector & Trigger Sync
1234
ActionNavigated to /studio/connectors as an authenticated admin.
ShowsConnectors dashboard — the starting state before any connector has been added. May show an empty list or connectors from prior test runs.
Create Connector & Trigger Sync
1234
ActionCreated connector via POST /studio/api/connectors with type='gdrive', then reloaded the page.
ShowsThe new connector 'My GDrive 431908' now appears in the connectors list with its type badge (GDrive) and a health status dot.
Create Connector & Trigger Sync
1234
ActionCalled POST /studio/api/connectors/{id}/sync — received ok:true. Also added a UC scope via POST /studio/api/connectors/{id}/scopes.
ShowsConnectors page after sync was triggered — the page still shows the connector list. The sync run was started in the background (a background task was created).
Create Connector & Trigger Sync
1234
ActionWaited 2 seconds for the background sync task to complete, then reloaded the page.
ShowsSync history table now shows the completed run — includes connector name, trigger type ('manual'), result status, and duration. The table auto-refreshes.

Role-Based Access Control

4 steps

RBAC enforcement: admin accesses connectors page → logout → viewer gets 403 on connectors → viewer can still see the hub.

Role-Based Access Control
1234
ActionAuthenticated as admin role, navigated to /studio/connectors.
ShowsAdmin user sees the full connectors UI — the 'Add Connector' button is visible. Only admin and editor roles can access this page.
Role-Based Access Control
1234
ActionNavigated to /auth/logout — server deleted the session cookie and redirected here.
ShowsLogin page shown after logout — the session cookie was cleared. User is redirected to /auth/login.
Role-Based Access Control
1234
ActionInjected a viewer-role JWT cookie, then navigated to /studio/connectors.
Shows403 Forbidden response — the server rejected the viewer's request to access /studio/connectors. The middleware checks role before rendering the page.
Role-Based Access Control
1234
ActionNavigated to /studio/ as a viewer. Same viewer cookie from the previous step.
ShowsStudio hub accessible to viewer — the main dashboard loads successfully. The hub is accessible to all authenticated roles; only admin/editor-only pages return 403.
